key_concepts: Common environmental problems include waste, water, land, and pollution
Illegal cutting of small trees, kaingin, improper waste disposal, pollution, deforestation
Environmental problems cause harmful effects on nature
Failure to care for the environment can lead to flooding and soil erosion
Students can help by not cutting trees
Students can help by not using dynamite in fishing
Students can help by not throwing garbage in streets
Proper environmental actions include watering plants and segregating waste
Harmful actions include throwing garbage in rivers, burning dried leaves, using fine-mesh
